headline.zh: 专注可持续生活方式的精品咖啡馆

traits.zh: 提供台湾特色精品咖啡与茶饮
traits.en: Offers specialty coffee and tea from Taiwan

traits.zh: 菜单上有多种经典咖啡饮品，如Flat White、Dirty等
traits.en: Menu includes classics like Flat White, Dirty

traits.zh: 店内有水泥柱、藤蔓植物和多肉植物装饰
traits.en: Decorated with cement pillars, vines, and succulents

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃窗带来良好视野
traits.en: Full street-facing windows for a great view

traits.zh: 周五至周日营业到晚上8点，周一至周四到下午6点
traits.en: Open until 8 PM on Fri-Sun, 6 PM Mon-Thu

focus.zh: 有操作区但未明确是否适合办公
focus.en: Has work area, but unclear if suitable

energy.zh: 临街位置可能有些许噪音
energy.en: Street location may have some noise

linger.zh: 有舒适的室内环境适合久坐

adventure.zh: 提供多种豆子选择，但主要是经典饮品
adventure.en: Multiple bean options, mainly classic drinks
